survey: A stylized black cat figure sits on a wooden plank floor in three-quarter view, turned toward the viewer's left. Head: round, with two pointed ears on top (the far ear foreshortened toward the back of the skull), two large yellow eyes with black pupils, and a small brown nose. There is no mouth, which is a normal simplification. A plain red collar wraps the neck where the head meets the chest; it has no buckle or tag, which is also a simplification. Body: an upright sitting pear shape with the hip and haunch bulging on the viewer's right. Two front legs come down from the chest and end in two rounded paws resting on the planks. The tail comes from behind the right haunch, sweeps forward along the floor and curls in front of the paws, so it hides where the back feet would be. The paws, haunch and tail all touch the floor, and the contact shadows ground the figure. Leg, ear and eye counts are correct, nothing floats, and there are no invented parts.
